about: The kinds of light. Read by js/levelgen.js, js/render.js, js/expression.js.

fields.full: how far it lights fully, squares from the flame
fields.dim: then a dim band this wide
fields.dark: then a faint band this wide (counted as dark, shown faintly)
fields.flame: the flame's size, times a campfire's
fields.foot: where it stands, squares below the light's middle
